title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
summary: Four sisters grow up in New England while their father is away at war and money is tight. Jo, the bookish and fiery second sister, dreams of becoming a writer.
readIf: you want a warm, old-fashioned family story that you can curl up with.
skipIf: you dislike sentimental or moralising passages, which this book has in places.

pairings.reason: Another classic about a spirited, imaginative girl growing up and finding her voice.
A witty classic about sisters, marriage and money, with a sharper edge.
A comforting classic about children growing stronger in a home that is slowly healing.
